instruction: Create three local folders in Thunderbird: WORK, PERSONAL, and NEWSLETTERS.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully created two local folders (COMPANY, UNIVERSITY) by right-clicking Local Folders, selecting New Folder, typing name, and clicking Create Folder. Completed in 9 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Thunderbird sidebar, right-click context menus, create local folders via New Folder dialog, type folder names
metadata.task_rationale: Extends original 2-folder creation to 3 folders, testing the same capability with slightly more repetition
metadata.explanation: Task requires creating 3 local folders instead of 2. Evaluator uses ls -R on Local Folders directory and check_list to verify each folder exists as both a directory entry and .msf file.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all three folders (WORK, PERSONAL, NEWSLETTERS) by checking both .msf files and directory entries in the Thunderbird Local Folders directory.
Postconfig correctly runs 'ls -R' on the Local Folders path to capture filesystem state before evaluation.
Getter (get_cache_file) correctly reads the cached ls output, and get_rule correctly passes the rules dict to check_list.
check_list metric correctly iterates over expected regex patterns and checks each line of the ls output, returning 1.0 only if all 6 patterns match.
Regex patterns are well-crafted: \bWORK\.msf\b matches the index file, \bWORK/?(?!\.msf) matches the directory entry without false-matching the .msf file.

Minor issue: scoring_breakdown in metadata suggests per-pattern partial credit (0.167 each), but check_list returns binary 0.0 or 1.0 (all-or-nothing). This is a metadata documentation inconsistency, not a verification logic error.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider noting in scoring_breakdown that check_list returns binary (all-or-nothing) rather than partial credit per pattern, to avoid confusion about grading granularity.
